record_audits.database_subject: Antibacterial Activity and Mechanisms of TroHepc2-22, a Derived Peptide of Hepcidin2 from Golden Pompano (Trachinotus ovatus).
record_audits.database_value: Sequence analysis: APD analysis reveals that this sequence is similar (81.82%) to hepcidin TH1-5 C: 36%, G=R: 14%. Chemical modification: N-terminal acetylation and C-terminal amidation. Activity: Active against Gram+ S. agalactiae LFY-5 (MIC 16 uM), S. aureus ATCC6538 (MIC 8 uM), Gram- E. piscicida (MIC 32 uM), V. harveyi QT520 (MIC 16 uM), V. alginolyticus HN08155 (MIC 64 uM), and E.coli ATCC8739 (MIC 128 uM). Structure: predicted to be beta-sheet. MOA:bacteria: depolarized and permeated bacterial membranes of S. agalactiae, S. aureus, E. piscicida, and V. harveyi. Updated 7/2025

activity_match.supported_mic_values: S. agalactiae 16, S. aureus 8, E. piscicida 32, V. harveyi 16, V. alginolyticus 64, E. coli 128 uM
